notes:
Summary: Financial research portal (equities + macro research) looking to replace a fragmented search stack with a central RAG-enabled portal. Primary focus = embeddings + reranking for better relevance on analyst queries.

Scale/traffic: SI estimates ~15-25M docs (reports, filings, models, notes). Peak QPS target 200-300, sustained daytime QPS ~80-120. Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms, p99 < 500ms. Must keep end-to-end query cost low; target cost per query (embeddings + rerank) < $0.01 ideally.

Model & infra preferences: Prefer open/quantized embedding models for cost control; plan to use a two-stage flow: cheap embeddings index (vector DB) -> lightweight transformer reranker for top-10. Want ability to route to smaller re-ranker on latency-sensitive endpoints. Dedicated capacity preferred to control unit economics and ensure predictable latency.

Security & compliance: EU data residency required (primary region Ireland), KMS integration mandatory with HSM-backed keys, SOC2 + ISO27001 required, full audit logs + retention controls (7 years for regulatory notes). SSO/SAML already in place; want IdP integration tested during POC.

POC ask: 2-week perf POC on Dedicated (Redwood Dedicated preferred) with sample 2M doc slice (full scale run to 20M for stress). Metrics: index build time, query latency distribution, cost per 1k queries, tail latency under load, memory & GPU utilization. Also want reranking accuracy eval vs baseline (current Elastic BM25 + simple re-ranker).

Quotes / customer color: "We need the same relevance we get in analyst tools but with predictable costs — can't have token surprises." — Head of Research. Risk appetite low; procurement + legal will gate on residency & KMS.

Decision process & timeline: CIO + Head of Infra + Procurement. Legal sign-off is gating; expectation to finalize contract in April if POC meets perf and security checks.

Open items: Need definitive HSM spec from Redwood; latency SLA language for Dedicated; detailed cost model for 20M index, 200 QPS sustained. Also ask: automatic KV/prefix caching behavior, recommended batching for reranker, suggested embedding model/quantization profile.

Next steps (short): run POC perf tests (SE to provision test cluster), security workshop 2026-03-20, follow-up pricing cadence and contract template to procurement.
